title: Flow Wgpu Interaction Parity
description: Restore premigration flow node-graph rendering in wgpu: edges, handles, channels, labels, selection rectangle, LOD-adjusted content.
summary: Restored full premigration Flow wgpu interaction parity: (1) compositor overlay pass draws label glyphs and selection marquee/bounds above raster quads via overlay_ui_instances + ui_overlay_pass; (2) wheel always zooms, ctrl_or_meta for macOS selection, Dag/Flow pan via middle-mouse/alt/space+drag, wheel-zoom LOD pin with 120ms debounce; (3) double-click note edit with keyboard forwarding and caret blink; (4) evaluate runs on wasm, camera-only fixture sync no longer wipes preview state, initial evaluate on graph mount; (5) catalogue rows draggable with application/x-flow-widget MIME, ghost widget follows cursor during tree drag over node-graph, drop dispatches addWidget at cursor world position. Added regression tests in dag, flow_core, flow_plugin, ui_wgpu. Rebuilt wgpu wasm bundle.
